summary: Stream parallel snapshot ranges directly into a fully reserved target file
details: Reserve real filesystem space before downloading, including unallocated holes in older resumable targets.
Write bounded HTTP response buffers directly at each range offset instead of copying temporary payload chunks, avoiding duplicate payload writes.
Validate HTTP 206 and exact Content-Range, overwrite interrupted ranges from their start on retry, and retain durable checkpoint ordering plus final whole-file SHA-256 verification.
Exercise real curl against a local HTTPS fixture for parallel writes, redirects, interrupted transfers, older checkpoints, malformed responses, allocation failures, and failed fsync.
operator_actions: Ship the updated node kit and usdb-services image together so both host core downloads and container registry downloads use the new implementation.
Existing range checkpoints remain reusable; an already-running downloader continues using its loaded implementation.
